card: An ally came to the fort and asked you to recruit the keeper of the Harrowgate winter feeder. They say the keepers gather at the beekeepers' clearings in the western old-growth. This step is to travel to those clearings and ask who keeps Harrowgate Pass fed. Coin as promised, and the pick of whatever the job turns up. Word runs that the one at the heart of this would be worth a place on any roster.

An ally came to the fort and pressed a worn sketch of the west woods into your palm. A new clearing is marked on the sketch where beekeepers meet, and several old trails lead to it. The client wants to recruit the keeper of the Harrowgate winter feeder so she will join the company and secure their winter supply line. Coin as promised, and the pick of whatever the job turns up. Word runs that the one at the heart of this would be worth a place on any roster.

The ally came to the fort and says the winter feeder at Harrowgate needs a keeper. A scout brought word of smoke and apiary clearings in the western forests. The change is clear on the map: the clearings are the nearest lead anyone can point at. Coin as promised, and the pick of whatever the job turns up.

A trader came to the fort asking you to find the keeper who feeds Harrowgate Pass. Fresh smoke and new tracks mark the beekeepers' clearings outside the wood. The trader fingers a wrapped jar and says the feeder keeps whole villages fed through winter. Coin as promised, and the pick of whatever the job turns up, and word runs that the one at the heart of this would be worth a place on any roster.

A fresh smear of wax coats the iron post at Harrowgate Pass and someone there tended the winter plinth very recently. The steward shows you the strip of honeycomb a forager traded for a ration. Your goal is to recruit the keeper of the Harrowgate winter feeder so she will join the company and secure their winter supply line. Travel to the beekeepers' clearings and learn who keeps the pass fed. Coin as promised, and the pick of whatever the job turns up. Word runs that the one at the heart of this would be worth a place on any roster.

Gundo of Millbrook has named Fenmarket as the place to begin inquiries. He asks that Romlyn be brought to Gundo at Millbrook alive. Your job is to go to the market and ask vendors about Romlyn. The client pays the agreed coin, and the company keeps whatever the road turns up. Word runs that the one at the heart of this is worth more than a season of common hires.

Gundo of Millbrook named Fenmarket and pressed the coin for questions. Fenmarket is busy with traders and entertainers and one of them may be Romlyn. The immediate need is who in the market knows Romlyn's recent wanderings. The client pays the agreed coin, and the company keeps whatever the road turns up. Word runs that the one at the heart of this is worth more than a season of common hires.

Gundo of Millbrook unrolled a faded playbill and tapped the name Romlyn. Fenmarket sits on the river and brims with traveling entertainers and vendors who trade news. What must happen now is to learn whether anyone at Fenmarket knows where Romlyn went or which stall he favors. The client pays the agreed coin, and the company keeps whatever the road turns up. Word runs that the one at the heart of this is worth more than a season of common hires.

Gundo of Millbrook presses a torn playbill into your hand and names Romlyn by the stage name on it. He lays out a short list of riverside stalls a returned trader mentioned. The traders at Fenmarket now hold the only lead anyone in Millbrook can point to. Gundo asks that Romlyn be brought alive so Romlyn can choose his fate. The client pays the agreed coin, and the company keeps whatever the road turns up. Word runs that the one at the heart of this is worth more than a season of common hires.

Gundo of Millbrook has sent word and named Fenmarket as the place to begin inquiries. Fenmarket is a riverside market where traveling entertainers and merchants trade news. The goal is to have Romlyn delivered alive to Gundo at Millbrook. The client pays the agreed coin, and the company keeps whatever the road turns up. Word runs that the one at the heart of this is worth more than a season of common hires.

Syndus lays a rough map on the table and points at Fernbank Hollow. His report just arrived at the fort and names that hollow as where Lariane was last seen. Syndus says he wants Lariane the Elder returned alive to Syndus at his manor. Honest coin for the work, and any small spoils ride home besides. They say the one at the heart of this would fetch a ransom worth a season of contracts.

Syndus spreads a damp scrap and points to Fernbank Hollow as the place Lariane was last seen. The scrap is a hurried report and it names tracks and a broken hunting cloak. The company must find Lariane the Elder alive at that hollow or show proof she is gone. Honest coin for the work, and any small spoils ride home besides. They say the one at the heart of this would fetch a ransom worth a season of contracts.

Syndus came to the fort and laid out a report that Lariane was last seen at Fernbank Hollow. The hollow's tracks are fresh but muddled by last night's rain. Syndus wants Lariane returned alive to his manor. Honest coin for the work, and any small spoils ride home besides. They say the one at the heart of this would fetch a ransom worth a season of contracts.

Syndus came to the gate and named Fernbank Hollow as where his watcher last saw Lariane. Return Lariane the Elder alive to Syndus at Syndus's manor. Syndus pressed a damp scrap of map into your hands and warned he will pay for a live return, not a corpse. Fernbank Hollow is low, wet ground where exile tracks vanish into reeds, and Syndus's report may be wrong or stale. Honest coin for the work, and any small spoils ride home besides, and they say the one at the heart of this would fetch a ransom worth a season of contracts.

Syndus handed the fort a short report and named Fernbank Hollow as where Lariane was last seen. The report is a claim, not a proof; no one from the fort has confirmed it. Syndus wants Lariane returned alive to his manor. Honest coin for the work, and any small spoils ride home besides. They say the one at the heart of this would fetch a ransom worth a season of contracts.
